name: kalshi-weather-markets
title: Kalshi Weather Markets: Prices vs Forecast Odds
description: Every open Kalshi weather market: daily high and low temperature in ~30 US cities, rain and snow. Live bid/ask and implied probability next to an 82-member ECMWF+GFS ensemble forecast probability for the exact settlement station, with today's observed high/low. $0.005 per market.
